answer:
Done — I made a polished App side for “Reading log” with:

- Cover-style book cards generated from the existing table
- Average rating, total books, books this year, and latest finish stats
- Books-per-month chart for the last 6 months
- “Want to read” chips from your existing note text

I kept the table itself unchanged.
